tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List devplane.dev's public reference entry pages with route, canonical URL, title and description. Detailed documentation and answers are listed by list_docs and list_faqs.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: List every question/answer pair from https://devplane.dev/faq — questions on multi-agent orchestration, operator cockpits, diagnosis, and comparisons, answered directly.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Get one FAQ entry by slug (from the list_faqs catalog), e.g. what-is-multi-agent-orchestration.

tools.name: list_comparisons
tools.description: List every comparison from https://devplane.dev/compare — DevPlane vs. a single AI assistant, vs. an issue tracker, and multi-agent vs. single-agent — each with the full side-by-side dimension table and verdict.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Read public documentation, including each topic's reference, private-pilot or planned status. This does not execute workflows.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read one public documentation topic by slug. Availability labels are part of the content.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_pages" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List devplane.dev's public, crawlable marketing pages (home, explain, compare, faq) with route, canonical URL, title and description. Excludes the secret-gated internal editor." → after: "List devplane.dev's public reference entry pages with route, canonical URL, title and description. Detailed documentation and answers are listed by list_docs and list_faqs."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
